IEM Market Tracker V1

How it works

Market Value

Based on the last 90 days of closed sales when at least 3 usable samples exist. Otherwise, older sales are weighted by recency. With few sales, long-unsold listings may lower the estimate; they do not count as sales.

Liquidity / Confidence

A 0–100 score based on sample count, freshness, source diversity, and price consistency. Higher scores indicate stronger supporting data.

Before buying

Estimates can contain errors. Check the original listing for availability, condition, accessories, currency, and seller history.

Search & Filters

Search by IEM name, brand, model keyword, driver config, or release year. Press Enter to open the first match.
